text:
Olga: Heads-up — p99 token latency on the token SLI dashboard spiked ~2x for eu-west in the last 10m :grimacing:
Henry: saw it, tokens/sec also dropped across several shards
Miguel: any NIC or network errors showing up?
Olga: node-exporter shows modest RX errors on host-gpu-12 and kernel tx queues with a backlog on a few hosts
Observability Bot: alert fired: token_latency_p99_eu-west > 450ms for 3m (rule: token-p99-eu-west-redline)
Tara: can we decompose the p99 into queueing vs compute vs cold-start vs network?
Kevin: +1. we should make a decomposition panel: queue_wait | kv_cache_miss_infer | model_infer | network
Olga: quick PromQL I'm testing to approximate components:

# queue wait avg
sum(rate(request_queue_time_seconds_sum{region="eu-west"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{region="eu-west"}[5m]))

# model inference avg
sum(rate(model_infer_time_seconds_sum{region="eu-west"}[5m])) / sum(rate(model_infer_requests_total{region="eu-west"}[5m]))

# network RTT approx (node-level receive histogram)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(node_network_receive_seconds_bucket{region="eu-west"}[5m])) by (le))

Henry: good. also add a per-model p99 trend; might be concentrated on a heavy model or a recent model rollout
Tara: run this to find hot models: topk(5, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{job="inference", le!="+Inf"}[5m])) by (model)) and inspect the 0.99 bucket
Kevin: KV cache hit ratio matters — if it drops, tokens/sec and latency correlate
Olga: confirmed: kvcache_hit_ratio in eu-west dropped from ~87% to ~62% at spike start
Miguel: that explains increased full-infer traffic
Henry: cost perspective: more full inference ~= >2x compute cost for affected tokens. Finance asked for a per-model cost signal on the SLI dashboard
Tara: proposal: add a dashboard row with p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, kv_cache_hit_ratio, est_cost_per_minute (derived)
Olga: simple est_cost_per_minute example PromQL (placeholder per-token costs omitted for brevity):

(sum(rate(infer_tokens_generated{region="eu-west"}[1m])) * <per-token-cost>) + (sum(rate(cache_miss_tokens{region="eu-west"}[1m])) * <full-infer-cost>)

Henry: alert tuning idea: make composite alert that fires when p99 > threshold AND kv_cache_hit_ratio < 75% OR tokens/sec < baseline * 0.7. reduces paging noise for transient events
Kevin: agree. add suppress window: firing requires 5m sustained, page only if sustained 15m
Miguel: adding quick ops checklist for on-call when this happens:
- check kvcache metrics and recent deploys
- inspect NIC RX/TX error counters on impacted hosts
- run per-model p99 query (topk)
- validate model router for hotshard imbalance
- escalate infra if RX errors > 100/min on any host

Olga: creating new dashboard panel: "Token SLI decomposition (eu-west)" — stacked bars for queue|kv-miss|infer|network per 1m bucket
Observability Bot: dashboard update: panel created by Olga in org/infra - ID 3819
Tara: can you add drilldowns to node detail and model profile pages?
Olga: will do. assigning follow-ups:
- Olga: add per-model cost metric + decomposition panel (ETA 30m)
- Miguel: update alert rule to composite + paging window (ETA 1h)
- Henry: run probe on NIC queues and post logs (ETA 15m)
- Kevin: calc per-model cost baseline for finance (ETA EOD)

Kevin: I linked a note in the cost board referencing this thread
Olga: thanks — will post a summary in #eng-platform once panels & alerts validated
Tara: :thumbsup:
Henry: if this recurs after kvcache refill, consider temporary autoscale bump for eu-west dedicated pool
Miguel: noted in runbook as an option
Olga: saving queries to /dashboards/token-sli/decomp/eu-west for auditing
Observability Bot: thread closed automatically after no activity for 60m
